message: Closes #<issue_number_or_delete_if_none>        ### PR Type     - [x] New feature        ### Summary     This PR unifies metadata management for the `.git-courer/` directory. It ensures metadata is hidden from LLM context prompts to    save tokens, automatically stages metadata files before commits, and reconciles the commits history cache (`commits.json`) against   `git log` dynamically.        ### Changes Table     | File | Change |     |------|--------|     | `internal/core/domain/metadata.go` | Added `MetadataDir` constant and `IsMetadataPath` path classification helper. |               | `internal/infra/chunkers/diff.go` | Renamed `filterTestFiles` to `filterExcludedFiles` and added metadata filtering to exclude   `.git-courer/` from LLM diff chunks. |     | `internal/adapters/commitstore/adapter.go` | Implemented `Reconcile` method using atomic temporary write-and-rename writes to    sync cache with `git log`. |     | `internal/workflow/commit.go` | Added `stageMetadataFiles` helper to auto-stage unstaged or untracked metadata files before      generating porcelain staged diffs. |     | `internal/delivery/mcp/core/commit_handler.go` | Wired log reconciliation and plumbing-path auto-staging into the MCP preview    and tree writing operations. |        ### Test Plan     - [x] Tested domain path classifiers and chunker exclusions via unit tests.     - [x] Verified atomic commitstore log reconciliation with mock-free file-write test suite.     - [x] Tested workflow and MCP handler integrations using mock-spy test cases.     - [x] Ran full repository test suites: `go test -count=1 ./...` (All tests passing).        ### Contributor Checklist     - [x] Linked an approved issue (if applicable)     - [x] Added exactly one `type:*` label     - [x] Ran all tests successfully     - [x] Followed conventional commit format     - [x] No `Co-Authored-By` trailers
